ra.schonBearbeitet: Policy work has already begun or the situation has eased. This response is no longer needed; the daily review closes the request without an additional relationship penalty.
ra.intro: When a troubled department receives no new policy action or conversation for 30 days, its minister raises a request. Up to three requests can be open at once. Reading is not a decision.
ra.bitte: “{groesse} stands at {wert}. I need a decision and want to discuss the next steps personally.”
ra.nachGespraech: “Thank you for the conversation. I still need a policy response on {groesse}. Listening alone does not clear the backlog.”
ra.zurueckgewiesen: “You declined the discussion. The problem with {groesse} remains. You can still respond before the deadline.”
ra.keinVorschlag: No executable bill proposal currently exists; discussion and existing department tools remain available.
ra.ohneEigenGut: Without a policy response by the deadline, this ambitious minister is expected to act independently: limited administrative action, department indicator improves by 1.2 points, one-off cost 0.01% of GDP, legitimacy −0.3. This does not replace laws or majorities.
ra.ohneEigenSchlecht: Without a policy response, this ambitious but less capable minister is expected to act alone. The intervention worsens the department indicator by 0.8 points and costs 0.01% of GDP and 0.3 legitimacy.
ra.ohneStill: Without a policy response, this minister waits. Unresolved work worsens the department indicator by 1.5 points at the deadline; trust in government −0.3.
ra.fristRegel: If the issue remains critical and unaddressed, expiry also costs 2 loyalty and adds 3 resentment. Following an explicit refusal, this relationship penalty is not charged again; independent action adds 1 further resentment. Later developments may change the outcome.
ra.haushaltFolge: Budget step: planned deficit {n} percentage points; legitimacy {leg}.
ra.folgen: Ministers: action and inaction in review
ra.folgenGrenze: These records show the effects actually booked at each step. Other crisis and monthly effects are additional. A policy response does not automatically resolve the crisis.
ra.veraltet: This request or its displayed terms have changed. Please review again.
ra.bereitsGeredet: This request has already been discussed. A policy step is now needed.
ra.nurEinmal: This request has already been deferred once.
ra.erinnerungEigen: After receiving no policy response, I acted independently.
ra.erinnerungStill: My department waited for a decision; work remained unresolved.
ra.antwort.reden: You listened. The policy response will be checked again in 21 days; the conversation alone does not change the department indicator.
ra.antwort.umsetzen: The proposal is underway. Pending bills still require their majority; policy effects follow the respective procedure.
ra.antwort.spaeter: The response deadline was extended once by 7 days. This costs 1 loyalty and adds 1 resentment; the problem remains.
ra.antwort.ablehnen: Refusal costs 3 loyalty and adds 5 resentment. If the problem remains unaddressed at the deadline, the stated independent action or deterioration follows.
ra.merke.ablehnen: My concern about {groesse} was turned down.
